scripts.docker:fresh: docker compose down -v && docker compose up
scripts.docker:prune: docker compose down -v --rmi all --remove-orphans && docker volume prune -f
scripts.test:unit: bun run test:games:unit && bun run test:wallets:unit
scripts.test:e2e: bun run test:games:e2e && bun run test:wallets:e2e
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e
